content: Bu Karridjawan God Kabenbun Birriwarre Bininj.

Ngudda bininj nawu ngurrbenmarnewohrnawohrnan dja ngurringeykimuk, yiddok ngurridjalyime kore mandjad bu ngudda ngurrbendjadme bininj? Yiddok ngurrbendjaddjadme bininj kore kunwoybuk dja kunmak dorrengh?
Burrkyak duninjh! Ngudda bu kanjdji baybaywi ngurridjaldjare kunwarre ngurrikurduyime. Munguyh ngurrbenbun bininj kore kondah kurorre.
Nawu birriwarre bininj wanjh kabirridedjingmang kunwarre kabirriyime bu bedda kerrngehkenh kabirringalme dja kabirrikurrehkurren kore birridjalyahwurd! Bedda kabirridjalre kore bedberre manbolh.
Bedda yiman kayime nabang nayin, dja kabirrikarrme manbang kore kurrang bedberre. Mak kabirrikanembalhmerren yiman nayin nabang nawu cobra.
Dja mak minj kabindibekkan birrimak bininj bu kabirriwokdi, yiman cobra nayin minj nangale bininj kabibekkan.
O God Yawey, nawu birriwarre bininj kabirriyime yiman kayime nabang lions, wanjh yibenyidmebakkemen bedberre, dja wardi yibenyidmeyerrkke kore kurrang bedberre!
Ngadjare bu kabirridjalyakmen rowk yiman kukku bu kaboyakmen kore kurorre. Ngadjare mak bu kabirridjalbarabun kore kunwarre kabirrikurduyime.
Ngadjare mak bu kabirridjaldowe yiman duberrk bu kakukkelkdan dja kadjalyakmen rowk. Ngadjare bu bedda kabirridjaldowe yiman nabarrken nawu karrowen bu kangalme, dja minj kabolknan.
Ngadjare God wanjh kundjalburrikudji kabuhme kunyid duninjh dorrengh bu kabenkukburriwe birriwarre bininj, dja kabirriyakwon rowk.
Nawu birrimak bininj wanjh kabirrinjilngmak bu kabindinan birriwarre kore God kabenbun bedberre dja karrengedjuhme kore bedberre kunkurlba.
Kaluk birriwarlahkenh bininj rowk kabirriyime, “Yoh, woybukkih. God kabenwon kunmakmak nawu birrimak bininj. Nungka wanjh woybukkih kandjadme ngad karriwarlahkenh bininj kondah kurorre.”
